Every mathematical integer has a decimal integer spelling; lexical adapter checks remain separate.

A string consisting of x followed by U+0000 is permitted by the contract. Literal U+0000 is illegal in JSON strings; the needed Unicode escape is absent from the candidate generic string language. This loses a semantic value, not merely an alternative spelling.
